body:
GREG, 2026-11-15 about 19:26Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1284, message ebe469ac), verbatim: „Process jest zbyt ciezki. Za duzo krokow dla agentow. Zawsze ktos cos pomysli. Generalnie co potrzebujemy id taska i branch. Tak? + kimi. Powtorze odrzucenie musi dawac powod.”
Asistant's brief, a paraphrase: Kimi analyses with both teams the target MINIMAL agent interface. The agent gives a task id and a branch; the system itself recognises and binds the actual execution, source_id/commit, host and result, keeping the existing safeguards. Check the cases where extra input is truly needed, and why. Make a concrete end-to-end simplification proposal: no new protocols and no more manual steps. Every refusal or hold gives its reason and a possible remedy. Separate facts from design, and report the plan and its owners. Sync and EO continue.
Context the same evening: Kimi's credit-chain analysis (c15db92c #204) found a passing remote run lost because factual placement and credit authority share one field, with silent Option/bool stops.
